name: How do I choose the right general contractor for my rental property maintenance needs?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right general contractor for my rental property maintenance needs?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a general contractor for rental property maintenance, look for licensed, insured professionals with a strong track record. Verify their CSLB license, check references, and review their portfolio of similar projects. Ensure they have experience working with rental properties and understand the unique demands of tenant relations and property management. A contractor who provides clear communication, transparent pricing, and timely service, like City Dweller, LLC, is essential for a successful partnership.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a general contractor who is licensed, insured, has strong references, and experience with rental properties. Prioritize clear communication, transparent pricing, and timely service.
